formula: r = (V1 - X) / V0 - 1 on the gold market_value_eod of 2026-04-21 (V1) and 2026-04-20 (V0), carried_days 1 so the producer's linked chain is the endpoint term; diff = abs(r - (holdings_price_return + income_return)); X = external_flow (null is 0) before, plus the receipt value as the inflow, minus it as the outflow; agree when diff <= the 2026-04-21 manifest tolerance
words: The leading security is ticker VUG. Of 972 accounts, flagged or not, with an IC|RO receipt of VUG on 2026-04-21, 920 are flagged accounts, and all 920 form the cohort. Counted as an external inflow, the receipt brings the guard to agreement within the manifest tolerance in 913 of the 920 cohort accounts, where before the receipt 0 agreed; the receipt moves all 920 cohort accounts closer to the holdings price return. The direction control counts the same receipts as outflows, and 0 of 920 agree. The 7 accounts that do not reconcile fall as follows: 1 within twice the tolerance, 4 within ten times, and 2 beyond ten times. The 52 receipt accounts outside the flagged set are not part of the guard question. Under the stated rule the verdict is IN_KIND_RECONCILES, because 913 of 920 is at least 95 percent. In plain terms, the receipts behave as external in-kind inflows: the account value rises by the receipt with no market move, which is what a contribution in kind would look like. What this does not show is whether the transfers are ACAT-style contributions of new holdings or a custodian re-registration of holdings the account already held; the feed cannot say that. The IC|RO classification is therefore a design fork for the CRO, and no classification, guard or served value is changed or proposed here.
